title: Using a vehicle for a big delivery
target: How to make use of a vehicle in Supermarket Simulator for a large delivery, instead of carrying everything in by hand.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A delivery large enough to be worth it

steps.do: Buy the vehicle before the delivery you need it for, not after it arrives.
steps.because: vehicles are sold as items in the shop (VehicleSaleItem)

steps.do: Work at the vehicle rather than carrying everything by hand.
steps.because: the game keeps vehicle boxes and a restock area controller (VehicleRestockAreaController)

steps.do: Get in through the interaction rather than expecting it to drive itself.
steps.because: a player enters a vehicle through its own interaction (VehicleInteract)

steps.do: Learn what you are driving, since each vehicle is configured by the game.
steps.because: the game keeps vehicle data and a loader for it (VehicleDataLoader)

steps.do: Do not assume other players see something different.
steps.because: vehicles are carried on the network (NetworkVehicle)

commonMistakes: Buying a vehicle with nowhere to keep it.
Leaving stock sitting in the vehicle instead of shelving it.
Expecting the vehicle to move without a driver.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
